name: Classic hatches, v4, middle scale (AI draft)

items.text: Classic hatches, v4: middle scale. Hatch items; they draw once the hatch keys are on main. AI draft: verify before use.
1  BRICK. Running bond, about four courses in the symbol. Joints anchored to the origin, so the pattern tiles across any size. Interior lines at the finest weight.
2  STONE. Rubble packed densely: one random layout of cells with a thin route gap between stones. The layout repeats every 2.4 paper in, so it tiles seamlessly.
3  CONCRETE. Dots spread at random with an even minimum distance, so the tone reads as one shade. Sharp triangles, rotated at random, repeat every 1.6 paper in.
4  STEEL. Diagonal lines rising to the right, as pairs at minus 45 degrees, spacing 0.28 paper in. Confirm the pair against the sheet.
